entities.summary: Dmitry Ivanovich Dedov is a Russian judge and corporate law scholar who has served as judge of the European Court of Human Rights in respect of Russia from 2013 to 2022 and previously as judge of the Russia's High Court of Arbitration from 2008 to 2012.
